dataset_manifest.weather_policy: Equal eligible station weight; thresholds in frozen plan
limitations: Station network varies; equal station weight is not area weight
Reported fires and sizes are not a complete final-area census
Monthly measurements can contain partial-day coverage
Six reused evaluation years overlap a previously inspected incident study; not a pristine holdout
31 training observations and historical station/reporting changes
Retrospective sources and missing availability prevent operational forecast claims
Exact local simulation; no device advantage
No confidence/significance claim from three seeds or six years
